images.filename: The Burton Cooper statue - Coopers Square, Burton upon Trent (26826617022).jpg
images.caption:
The Burton Cooper statue seen inside the Coopers Square, shopping centre in Burton upon Trent.
It was created in 1977 by James Butler. The bronze statue depicts a cooper, a traditional local craftsman.

It was moved to its current location in 1994.
